theorems.name: Submission.classical_tangent_uniform_lower_density
theorems.statement: LpMonotonicity → LpDensity → LpSupportRepresentation → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (H : Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ) (p : ℝ) (x : Ambient n ℓ), 0 < n → IsOpen U → V.HasMeanCurvatureIn U H → V.MultiplicityGE 1 U → (n : ℝ) < p → V.IsLocallyLp U H p → x ∈ U → ∃ ρ₀ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₀ ∧ ∀ ζ ∈ V.support ∩ closedBall x ρ₀, ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ ρ₀ → omega n / 2 * s ^ n ≤ V.weight.real (closedBall ζ s)
